details.tactics:
CONTROL THE GAP

USE  Use cover between draws and keep the next target in view.

COUNTER  Solid cover stops the arrow. Move across the archer's aim rather than toward it.

FOLLOW-UP  Use Measured Step to change your angle, then draw again.

details.tactics:
BREAK A FORMATION

USE  Line up a troop column before committing to the longer draw.

COUNTER  Break the firing line behind solid cover; piercing does not pass through walls.

FOLLOW-UP  Reposition with Measured Step after recovery to avoid returning fire.

details.tactics:
HOLD GROUND TOGETHER

USE  Place the fixed circle where you and allied troops can stay inside it.

COUNTER  Healing requires staying inside the fixed circle; an existing shield lasts until expiry. Solid cover blocks placement.

FOLLOW-UP  Protect a lane position, then draw while your allies advance.

details.tactics:
COMMIT THREE LANES

USE  Aim before casting: all three firing lanes lock when the draw begins.

COUNTER  Move sideways during the warning or use solid cover; every arrow stops at its first target.

FOLLOW-UP  Use Measured Step first to open an angle. Three marks during the cast show pending and launched lanes, not charges or hits.
